name: 背景底板
function: 建立可复用的材质、色彩和活动区域。
visual_prompt_seed: clean reusable background plate, tactile material texture, asymmetrical composition, quiet title-safe area, no characters, no text
video_prompt_seed: mostly stable background with only subtle material movement or parallax
sfx: soft room tone or material ambience

name: 独立角色入场
function: 让角色/讲解者像舞台演员一样进入。
visual_prompt_seed: single isolated cutout character, consistent outline and soft shadow, clear pose, neutral extraction background
video_prompt_seed: character slides or steps a short distance onto the background plate, then settles
sfx: paper glide, cloth rustle or light footstep

name: 关键道具弹入
function: 让一个概念、部件或剧情触发物成为焦点。
visual_prompt_seed: single isolated hero prop as a paper-cut element, tactile edge, simple contour, no text
video_prompt_seed: prop enters with a small elastic settle, without excessive bounce
sfx: card drop, object tap or world-specific foley

name: 场景窗口
function: 在底板与真实/故事现场之间建立通道。
visual_prompt_seed: realistic or illustrated scene framed as a separate torn-edge window card, title-safe margin around it
video_prompt_seed: scene window expands smoothly into the full frame or shrinks back into the collage board
sfx: photo card land, scene ambience fades in

name: 关系组装
function: 让多个独立元素表达因果、对比、组合或剧情互动。
visual_prompt_seed: three separated collage elements arranged with clear hierarchy and generous breathing room, no readable labels
video_prompt_seed: elements arrive in causal order and lock into one readable composition
sfx: successive paper taps, small connector click

name: 纸边转场
function: 用实体材料切换章节或状态。
visual_prompt_seed: torn paper edge, folded flap, card edge or sticker occluder prepared as a transition layer
video_prompt_seed: one paper layer wipes across the frame and reveals the next background or scene window
sfx: paper tear, tape peel or page turn

name: 概念分解/组装
visual_prompt_seed: one main object separated into a few clear modular paper-cut parts, no labels, ordered spacing
video_prompt_seed: parts separate, reveal a relationship, then reassemble with believable spacing

name: 情绪特效层
function: 用可控的小元素强化卡通情绪或科普重点。
visual_prompt_seed: small isolated paper-cut effect elements such as puff, sparkle, line burst or cloud, restrained palette
video_prompt_seed: one effect appears briefly around the hero element and disappears after the beat
sfx: bubble pop, pencil flick or airy puff

name: 全板记忆点
function: 用完整且静止的组合留下最后印象。
visual_prompt_seed: wide hero collage composition, independent elements organized on one background plate, clear focal point, closing-text safe area
video_prompt_seed: slow pullback or stable hold after all elements settle
